name: Orchardale Estate
description: Grown in the beautiful hills of Yercaud, Tamil Nadu, hailing from the prestigious MSP Coffee group of estates, Orchardale estate has been a remarkable discovery for us!  The flavours are a result of mixing two different processing methods, one half is slow fermented & slow dried to impart deep rich flavours while the other half undergoes shorter fermentation and faster drying to impart brightness and crisp mouthfeel.

name: Ratnagiri Estate | Microbial Culture
description: This is it! THE MOST FLORAL coffee of the year! You can smell the rose notes metres away and your coffee will taste like actual petals crushed into a paste. A particular strain of yeast and lactic acid bacteria was added to the coffee in the fermenters and allowed to ferment for 86 hours in a carbon dioxide rich environment. After removing the coffee, they were directly put on raised beds for slow drying. The coffee was then dried slowly with constant stirring over the next 29 days.

name: Ratnagiri Estate | Yeast Natural
description: This one of a kind Yeast fermented and naturally dried lot from Ratnagiri Estate has an absolute flavour blast with a pleasantly lingering nutty taste with a hint of caramel like sweetness. The fruity aromas make it a very pleasant drink to have. Not to mention, all iced brews made with this are a superhit!
